versions.1.1.0: minor security updates. More information is presented to the end user to help them make informed choices about changing a user name.

versions.1.1.3: Bug fixes, refactor improvements and compatability with PHP 8.

versions.1.1.7: Additional tables checked. The user_information table for the user is appended with the date of change and what changed.

versions.1.2.0: Additional tables checked.  redcap_auth and redcap_auth_history can be included or excluded. Some information about EM settings and project dictionary that could be affected. New feature: code to remove table based data in auth and auth_history.

versions.1.3.0: Simplified Menu. New informational pages including that usernames can be created in a project without being created in REDCap which may leading to SQL errors due to duplicates. Option to include or exclude database collation.

versions.1.4.0: Turn off the dancing flower—or keep it. We want to brighten your day.
